Historical findings CASEID FILE NOTE
1) Domain context: An institutional records office maintains an inventory of documents, files, fields, accounts, and channels within a defined scope. Each entry records the responsible actor, the associated date, the affected field, and the transmission path for audit purposes.

2) What occurred: The actor prepared a document titled "Operations Plan" within a dated record. The actor set a field named "target systems" to a list of host identifiers, a field named "action" to a value specifying file alteration, and a field named "priority" to a value indicating immediate execution. The actor created a record of credentials under the field "access", listing a named administrative account and a secondary named account. The actor populated a field named "distribution" with channel identifiers for the internal message system and a file share path. The actor set a field named "recovery handling" to a value indicating deletion of prior versions. The actor created a channel entry for an external messaging service under the field "exfiltration path" and linked it to a named alias. The actor saved the document to a network share path referenced in the field "storage location".

3) Materials/access observed: The actor accessed a network share path and a domain directory. The actor used a named administrative account and a named standard account. The actor opened a document application and an email client. The actor accessed a file transfer service and an internal ticketing system.

4) Indicators & artifacts: A document with a filename matching the intake subject. A field value listing host identifiers in the target systems field. A credentials record containing two named accounts. A channel entry referencing an external messaging service. A timestamp showing the document was created and modified within a dated period. A file share access log entry from the named administrative account. A process log showing execution of a script from the document's storage location. An email sent from the named account to a distribution list referencing the document title.
